rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides access to Bright Security's dynamic application security testing (DAST) platform. Enables running security scans, discovering API endpoints, monitoring scan status, managing repeaters for internal target access, uploading API definitions, and reviewing discovered vulnerabilities. Supports scanning web applications, REST, SOAP, and GraphQL APIs.
